about.story:
Golden Business Machines, Inc. (GBM) is the local leader in providing businesses of all sizes with office copiers, printers, software solutions, managed IT services and top-notch service throughout Northeastern and Central Pennsylvania for over 50 years.

Founded by Joseph R. Bradley in 1969, GBM is a locally owned business headquartered in Kingston, PA with branch sales and service offices in Edwardsville, Scranton, Hazleton and Williamsport. This allows us to give you the attention you cannot receive from larger corporations, especially if their headquarters are located elsewhere.

GBM has always been a leader, providing customers with trusted solutions to help their organizations prosper. We became one of Canon's first Authorized Dealers for office equipment in the nation, and were among the area's first Microsoft Solutions Providers. Our partnership with Hewlett Packard began with printers and expanded to include computers and servers. Understanding the marketplace has been the key to over five decades of growth, success and industry leadership. GBM is comprised of over 45 dedicated sales and service professionals with the expertise to provide our clients with the document solutions and products required in today's complex business environment.

services.title: Copiers & Multifunction Printers
services.short_description: Network-ready black & white and color Canon MFPs for offices of every size, paired with the software that turns them into real workflow tools.
services.long_description: Whether you operate a small office or require an enterprise-level approach, GBM offers a network-ready range of black & white and color devices to meet your needs. When combined with the right software, these devices improve workflow efficiencies that lead to reduced costs and minimized waste. As an exclusive authorized Canon dealer, GBM's team of experts provides the solutions your business needs to improve workflow and print smarter both on-premises and in the cloud.
sub_services: Copy, print, scan and fax from one device
High-quality black & white and business color output
Finishing: stapling, booklet making, 2/3 hole punch, fold and Z-fold
Scan-to-email, FTP, network folder and fax distribution
Advanced device security and accessibility options
Remote device management, toner and job monitoring

services.title: Office Printers & Scanners
services.short_description: The right printer and the right scanner for how your office actually works — matched on speed, volume, security and cost per page.
services.long_description: Your documents are only as good as the device they were first printed on. Not all printers are cut from the same cloth, and making sure you have the right printer for your specific company needs makes a real difference in your ability to turn out affordable, quality documents. On the scanning side, GBM's line covers everything from 130-page-per-minute centralized production scanners down to 15 ppm mobile and distributed scanners — the simplest way to convert paper into electronic documents you can organize, store and share.
sub_services: Color and black & white office printers
Print quality, speed and volume matching

services.title: Wide Format & Digital Presses
services.short_description: Large-format and production printing in house — from 60-inch graphics work to digital presses running over 100 pages per minute.
services.long_description: Printing isn't limited to a standard sheet of paper. Architecture, engineering, construction, graphic arts and corporate teams all need wide-format output, and GBM offers state-of-the-art large format solutions built for speed, flexibility and quality — three distinct printer lines from 12-color for photography and graphics, to 8-color for production, to 5-color for technical documents, in sizes from 17 to 60 inches. On the production side, a digital press gives your business the competitive advantage of generating high volumes at a fraction of the cost, without hiring a print shop.
sub_services: MFP imaging systems for technical documents
Technical document and general use printers
High-speed output over 100 pages per minute

services.title: Managed IT Services
services.short_description: The manpower of an entire IT department without the cost of in-house staff — monitoring, security, backup and support across Northeastern PA.
services.long_description: IT Services from GBM give your business the manpower of an entire IT department without the need or cost of an in-house IT staff. GBM can provide all of your technical needs from workstations and servers to printers and connected multifunction devices, with call-to-repair services, support contracts and IT project management. We actively monitor your network and devices to identify potential threats, then act quickly to eliminate them before they create downtime — because the best IT security is cyberthreat prevention, not break-fix. Flexible pricing means you can choose pay-as-you-go or pre-paid support plans with tiered hours that never expire.

services.title: Managed Print & Document Management
services.short_description: Take control of what your office spends on printing, and move the paper it still produces into a searchable digital repository.
services.long_description: Businesses spend more on printing every year — some up to 3% of their annual budget. GBM's Managed Print Services program is a coordinated strategy to manage every aspect of every printing device on your network: consumables, hardware, service, support and device optimization, with frequent tracking of cost per page. Alongside it, document management has evolved into Enterprise Content Management, letting organizations digitize documents and automate document-driven processes so the right people access the right information at the right time.
sub_services: Quality toner supplies at reduced cost
Instant document capture and secure storage
Granular document security and digital forms

partner_narrative: Canon U.S.A. — GBM is an exclusive authorized Canon dealer for color copiers, digital presses, wide format printers and MFPs.
Hewlett-Packard — GBM is an authorized HP Reseller and Service Center for printers, computers and servers.
Microsoft — GBM was among the area's first Microsoft Solutions Providers and remains Microsoft Certified.
Laserfiche — enterprise content management software used by more than 28,000 organizations worldwide.
uniFLOW — print and MFP fleet control, built from components to match the environment.
Cisco — networking equipment for business infrastructure.
EFI — Fiery digital print controllers and production print management.
PaperCut — print management and secure release.
brand_voice_sample: Golden Business Machines (GBM) is a technology services company and exclusive authorized dealer of Canon Color Copiers, Digital Presses, Wide Format Printers and MFPs. We offer a full range of Managed IT Services including hardware, network support, and managed print services. Proudly serving Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, Kingston, Stroudsburg, Hazleton, Bloomsburg, Lewisburg, Williamsport and surrounding areas.
